docs.subject: Welcome to CloudLedger
docs.body:
Dear Ms. Navarro,

Welcome to CloudLedger! We are pleased that you have chosen our accounting software to manage {{1}} company's finances. Your account is now active, and you can log in at any time using the e-mail address you registered with.

To help you get started, one of our specialists will contact you within two business days to schedule a free onboarding session. {{2}} During this session, we will help you import your existing data and set up {{3}} reports.

If you have any questions in the meantime, our support team is available by chat from 8 A.M. to 8 P.M. {{4}}, you can consult the step-by-step guides in our online help center.

Best regards,
The CloudLedger Team

questions.explanation: Le mail s'adresse directement à Mme Navarro (« you have chosen ») : « your company's finances ».
questions.traps: « Yours » est un pronom qui ne peut pas précéder un nom.
questions.takeaway: Déterminant possessif cohérent avec le sujet (you → your).

options: The session usually lasts about an hour and can be held online.
Our offices will be closed next Monday.
Thank you for your recent payment.
questions.explanation: La phrase précédente annonce une séance de prise en main ; la phrase insérée en précise la durée et le format, puis « During this session » enchaîne.
questions.traps: Les autres phrases rompent le fil de la séance d'accueil.
questions.takeaway: Vérifie que la phrase suivante (During this session…) s'enchaîne aussi.

questions.explanation: Devant le nom « reports », il faut un adjectif ; le sens passif (des rapports personnalisés) impose le participe passé « customized ».
questions.traps: « Customizing reports » signifierait « des rapports qui personnalisent ».
questions.takeaway: Participe passé adjectif = sens passif (customized reports).

questions.explanation: Deux solutions sont proposées : le chat ou les guides en ligne. « Alternatively » (sinon, autre possibilité) introduit la seconde.
questions.traps: « Instead of » et « Despite » sont des prépositions, suivies d'un nom. « Therefore » exprime une conséquence.
questions.takeaway: Alternatively = ou bien, autre option.

docs.title: Bordeaux to Add Electric Bikes

questions.explanation: Les vélos arriveront au printemps prochain : futur « will be available ».
questions.takeaway: Repère les marqueurs de temps du texte (next spring).

questions.explanation: Le mot modifie l'adjectif « popular » : il faut l'adverbe « particularly ».
questions.takeaway: Adverbe + adjectif (particularly popular).

options: Bordeaux is famous for its wine.
Many riders, however, have complained that hills in some neighborhoods are hard to climb.
The tram network was built in 2003.
Parking fees will increase in May.
questions.explanation: Après le succès du programme, cette phrase présente une limite (les côtes difficiles) qui justifie l'arrivée de vélos électriques : elle relie les deux paragraphes.
questions.traps: (C) mentionne le tram, présent dans le texte, mais n'apporte rien à l'argument.
questions.takeaway: « However » signale une nuance : vérifie qu'elle prépare la suite du texte.

questions.explanation: On dit « in the city center » (dans le centre-ville), espace délimité.
questions.traps: « At » s'emploie pour un point précis (at the station).
questions.takeaway: In the city center / in the area.

docs.subject: Fire drill on Thursday
docs.body:
A fire drill will be held on Thursday, October 9, at 10:30 A.M. When the alarm sounds, please leave the building {{1}} the nearest emergency exit. Do not use the elevators.

Once outside, go directly to the assembly point in the north parking lot, where team leaders will check that everyone {{2}} the building. {{3}} The drill should last no more than twenty minutes.

Employees who will be meeting with clients at that time are asked to inform them in advance. We appreciate your {{4}}.

questions.explanation: On sort « par » une issue : « through the nearest emergency exit ».
questions.traps: « Among » et « between » expriment une position parmi plusieurs éléments.
questions.takeaway: Leave through / exit through = sortir par.

questions.explanation: « Everyone » est singulier ; l'action est achevée au moment du contrôle : « has left ».
questions.traps: « Everyone » évoque une pluralité mais impose un verbe au singulier.
questions.takeaway: Everyone / everybody / someone + verbe au singulier.

options: The new parking lot will open next month.
Fire extinguishers were invented centuries ago.
Please do not return to your desks until you are told it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: La consigne s'inscrit dans le déroulement de l'exercice : on attend au point de rassemblement avant de retourner aux bureaux.
questions.traps: (A) reprend « elevators », mais n'a pas de lien avec la séquence décrite.
questions.takeaway: Une phrase qui reprend un mot du texte n'est pas forcément la bonne.

questions.explanation: Après « your », il faut un nom : « cooperation ».
questions.takeaway: We appreciate your cooperation = merci de votre coopération.

docs.title: Riverside Fitness Center — Holiday Schedule
docs.body: From December 23 to January 2, the Riverside Fitness Center will operate on a reduced schedule: 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. daily. Group classes will be suspended during this period, but personal training sessions can still be booked at the front desk. Regular hours (6 A.M. to 10 P.M.) resume on January 3.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To announce temporary changes to opening hours
questions.evidence: will operate on a reduced schedule
questions.explanation: L'avis annonce des horaires réduits pendant les fêtes, puis le retour aux horaires normaux.
questions.takeaway: Reduced schedule = horaires réduits.

questions.prompt: What will be available during the holiday period?
questions.evidence: personal training sessions can still be booked
questions.explanation: Les cours collectifs sont suspendus mais les séances de coaching individuel restent réservables.
questions.traps: Les horaires 6 h–22 h ne reprennent que le 3 janvier.
questions.takeaway: « Still » = toujours possible malgré le changement.

docs.subject: Invitation — Nordic Retail Forum
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Berg,

On behalf of the organizing committee, I am writing to invite you to deliver the closing address at the Nordic Retail Forum, which will be held in Oslo on 12–13 May. Your recent book on customer loyalty has generated considerable interest among our members, and we believe your insights would be of great value to our audience of 400 retail executives.

The closing address is scheduled for 4 P.M. on 13 May and should last approximately 40 minutes, followed by a short question-and-answer session. We will, of course, cover your travel and accommodation expenses, and we are able to offer an honorarium of €2,000.

I would be grateful if you could let me know by 15 February whether you are available.

Kind regards,
Hélène Marchetti

questions.prompt: Why did Dr. Marchetti write to Mr. Berg?
options: To ask him to review a book
To invite him to speak at an event
questions.evidence: to invite you to deliver the closing address
questions.explanation: Elle l'invite à prononcer le discours de clôture du forum.
questions.takeaway: Deliver an address = prononcer un discours.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Mr. Berg?
questions.evidence: Your recent book on customer loyalty
questions.explanation: Il a récemment publié un livre sur la fidélisation client : c'est un auteur publié.
questions.takeaway: Inférence = déduction directe d'un détail du texte.

questions.prompt: In the e-mail, the word "cover" in paragraph 2, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.evidence: cover your travel and accommodation expenses
questions.explanation: « Cover expenses » = prendre en charge les frais, donc les payer.
questions.traps: « Report on » correspond à « cover a story » (journalisme), un autre sens.
questions.takeaway: Cover costs / expenses = prendre en charge.

messages.name: Yuki Tanaka
messages.text: Hello, I ordered a desk lamp (order #A7720) last week, and the tracking page says it was delivered yesterday. But I never received it.

messages.name: Leo (ShopNow Support)
messages.text: I'm sorry to hear that, Ms. Tanaka. Let me check. The courier's record shows it was left with a neighbor at number 12.

messages.name: Yuki Tanaka
messages.text: Oh, I live at number 21. That might explain it.

messages.name: Leo (ShopNow Support)
messages.text: That does seem likely. Could you check with your neighbors first? If you can't find it, I'll send a replacement at no charge.

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Tanaka contact ShopNow?
options: She wants to cancel an order.
A package she ordered did not reach her.
She wants to change her address.
questions.explanation: Le suivi indique une livraison, mais elle n'a jamais reçu sa lampe.
questions.takeaway: Tracking = suivi de colis.

questions.prompt: At 14:08, what does Ms. Tanaka mean when she writes, "That might explain it"?
options: She thinks the package was delivered to the wrong house.
She realizes she ordered the wrong item.
She believes the tracking page is broken.
questions.explanation: Le colis a été laissé au numéro 12 alors qu'elle habite au 21 : elle comprend que le livreur s'est probablement trompé d'adresse.
questions.takeaway: Relie l'expression à l'information qui la précède (12 / 21).

questions.prompt: What does Leo offer to do?
options: Send a new lamp free of charge if needed
questions.evidence: I'll send a replacement at no charge
questions.explanation: Si elle ne retrouve pas le colis, il enverra un remplacement gratuitement.
questions.takeaway: At no charge = free of charge = gratuitement.

docs.title: Lumora Pharmaceuticals to Build Research Center in Grenoble
docs.body:
GRENOBLE — Lumora Pharmaceuticals announced on Thursday that it will build a €45 million research center on the outskirts of Grenoble. Construction is scheduled to begin in April and is expected to be completed within eighteen months. [1]

The center will house up to 250 scientists working mainly on treatments for respiratory diseases. Lumora's chief executive, Dr. Anaïs Perrin, explained that the company chose Grenoble for its strong network of universities and research institutes. [2] "Being close to academic partners allows our teams to test ideas faster," she said.

Local officials welcomed the project, which is expected to create about 100 additional jobs in construction and services. [3] The regional government has also agreed to improve public transportation to the site. [4]

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A new treatment for respiratory diseases
The election of a regional government
A company's plan to build a new facility
questions.evidence: it will build a €45 million research center
questions.explanation: L'article annonce la construction d'un centre de recherche par Lumora.
questions.takeaway: Facility = installation, site.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned about the research center?
options: The number of scientists it will house
The name of its future director
questions.explanation: Le texte donne le coût (45 M€), la capacité (250 chercheurs) et le domaine (maladies respiratoires), mais pas le nom du futur directeur du centre.
questions.traps: Dr Perrin est la PDG de l'entreprise, pas la directrice du centre.
questions.takeaway: NOT : méfie-toi des noms cités dans un autre rôle.

questions.prompt: Why did Lumora choose Grenoble?
questions.evidence: for its strong network of universities and research institutes
questions.explanation: Grenoble a été choisie pour son réseau d'universités et d'instituts de recherche.
questions.takeaway: Academic institutions = universities and research institutes.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "A new bus line will connect the center to the main train station."
questions.explanation: La phrase illustre l'amélioration des transports publics annoncée juste avant la position [4].
questions.takeaway: Cherche la phrase qui annonce le thème (public transportation → bus line).

docs.title: Brightwave Training — Spring Workshops (Lyon)
docs.note: Groups of three or more from the same company receive a 15% discount. Lunch is included in full-day workshops.

docs.from: Sofia Lindqvist, HR Coordinator, Varden Logistics
docs.subject: Group registration
docs.body:
Hello,

I would like to register three of our team leaders, Paul Girard, Aminata Diallo, and Chen Wei, for the two-day workshop in March. Since our team leaders now manage staff working from several locations, I would also like to enroll Ms. Diallo in the half-day session at the end of the month.

Could you send the invoice to me directly? We would prefer to pay by bank transfer.

Thank you,
Sofia Lindqvist

questions.prompt: Which workshop will Mr. Girard attend?
questions.explanation: Mme Lindqvist inscrit les trois chefs d'équipe à l'atelier de deux jours : d'après le tableau, c'est « Project Management Basics ».
questions.takeaway: Une description (two-day workshop) renvoie à une ligne du tableau.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the Leading Remote Teams workshop?
questions.evidence: Lunch is included in full-day workshops.
questions.explanation: Le déjeuner n'est inclus que pour les ateliers d'une journée complète ; cet atelier dure une demi-journée.
questions.takeaway: Une règle générale + un cas particulier = inférence typique.

questions.prompt: How much will Varden Logistics most likely pay per person for the two-day workshop?
questions.explanation: Trois personnes de la même entreprise bénéficient de 15 % de réduction : 590 € × 0,85 = 501,50 €.
questions.traps: 590 € est le tarif sans la remise de groupe.
questions.takeaway: Vérifie toujours les conditions de réduction en note de bas de tableau.

questions.prompt: Why does Ms. Lindqvist want Ms. Diallo to attend an additional session?
options: Ms. Diallo is a new employee.
Ms. Diallo needs to improve her writing.
Team leaders supervise employees in different places.
questions.evidence: manage staff working from several locations
questions.explanation: Les chefs d'équipe encadrent désormais du personnel sur plusieurs sites : d'où l'atelier sur le management à distance.
questions.takeaway: Several locations = different places.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Lindqvist request?
options: That the invoice be sent to her
questions.evidence: Could you send the invoice to me directly?
questions.explanation: Elle demande que la facture lui soit envoyée directement.
questions.takeaway: Invoice = facture.

docs.title: Safety Notice — Voluntary Recall of KettlePro 2000
docs.body: Brevin Home Appliances is voluntarily recalling KettlePro 2000 electric kettles with serial numbers beginning with KP20-B, sold between June 1 and September 30. In rare cases, the handle may become loose after repeated use. No injuries have been reported. Customers should stop using the affected kettles and contact Brevin for a free replacement or a full refund. Proof of purchase is not required.

docs.subject: KettlePro recall
docs.body:
Hello,

I bought a KettlePro 2000 in August at Maxi Électro. Its serial number is KP20-B4471. I read about the recall in the newspaper. Although I have not had any problems with the handle, I would rather not take any risks. I no longer have the receipt. I would prefer a replacement rather than a refund, as I am otherwise very happy with the kettle. Could you tell me how to proceed?

Daniel Okafor

docs.subject: RE: KettlePro recall
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Okafor,

Thank you for contacting us. We will send you a prepaid shipping label so that you can return your kettle to us at no cost. Once we receive it, your new kettle, the updated KettlePro 2100 model, will be shipped within three business days. Please do not use your current kettle in the meantime.

Brevin Customer Support

questions.prompt: Why is the KettlePro 2000 being recalled?
questions.evidence: the handle may become loose after repeated use
questions.explanation: La poignée peut se desserrer à l'usage : une pièce peut devenir instable.
questions.traps: (C) est contredit : aucune blessure n'a été signalée.
questions.takeaway: Loose = desserré, mal fixé.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Mr. Okafor's kettle?
options: It is covered by the recall.
questions.explanation: Son numéro de série commence par KP20-B et il l'a acheté en août (entre le 1er juin et le 30 septembre) : la bouilloire est concernée par le rappel.
questions.traps: (C) est faux : il précise n'avoir eu aucun problème.
questions.takeaway: Vérifie chaque critère du rappel (série + dates).

questions.prompt: What is indicated about Mr. Okafor's missing receipt?
options: It will prevent him from getting a replacement.
He will receive a partial refund instead.
He must request a copy from Maxi Électro.
It is not needed to receive a new kettle.
questions.explanation: Il n'a plus son ticket, mais l'avis de rappel précise qu'aucune preuve d'achat n'est exigée ; la réponse de Brevin confirme l'échange.
questions.takeaway: Une inquiétude dans un document est souvent levée par un autre.

questions.prompt: What will Mr. Okafor receive first?
questions.evidence: We will send you a prepaid shipping label
questions.explanation: Brevin envoie d'abord une étiquette d'expédition prépayée ; la nouvelle bouilloire ne part qu'après réception de l'ancienne.
questions.takeaway: Once we receive it = dès réception (ordre des étapes).

questions.prompt: In the second e-mail, what is Mr. Okafor asked to do?
questions.evidence: Please do not use your current kettle in the meantime.
questions.explanation: On lui demande de ne plus utiliser sa bouilloire actuelle en attendant.
questions.takeaway: In the meantime = en attendant.
